name: find_sites
description: Find lunar landmarks and archive sites by name, or browse south polar candidates. Returns IDs and coordinates. Use IDs returned by this tool for subsequent tools.

name: screen_landings
description: Run the actual ALPHA LUNAR ranking and screening engine. Dates are UTC, rounded down to a whole hour. Can use up to 8 explicit site IDs, or omit them for the regional grid. Supports 0–28 days and 2026–2028 UTC. Supply a duration, priority, or mass only if requested or stated as an assumption.

name: inspect_site
description: Read coordinates, catalog provenance, high-resolution archive terrain and monthly reference data, and the bundled Diviner/PSR cell if available. Includes ice-evidence limitations. Month format YYYY-MM.

name: simulate_descent
description: Run the ALPHA LUNAR three-scenario Monte Carlo simulation. Use a site ID from find_sites or screen_landings. Optional massKg and thrustKN override concept defaults. The Apollo or rocket choice changes only the visual model. Returns results, assumptions and interactive simulation/risk actions.

name: compare_operations
description: Run a surface-operations comparison on 2 or 3 sites for lighting, battery, Earth geometry and modeled radio. Default inputs are editable study assumptions, not vehicle specs. start is an ISO UTC timestamp.

name: open_module
description: Attach a button that opens an application module for the user. Use for interactive navigation and report access. For numerical results call the calculation tools instead. An optional site ID chooses the location.
